title: Tracker-closed tick reads live '●review' when an older run is the subject
description:
mergedRuns.stateOf prefers any run's non-ready row over the tracker, and treats the subject run as the newest. When the subject is an older, ended run (here the stopped cloud run run_08f5 that `epic-hn6` resolves to from a checkout without the local feed), its stale 'dispatched' row for v16 wins over the tracker's closed status and over a later run that closed it. The table shows 'v16 review hn6 claim ▸ ●review ▸ … 21h23m'. A row from a run that has ended should not override a tracker-closed tick.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/epic.go:170-178; ticfac status epic-hn6 --json -> v16 state dispatched while .tick/issues/v16.json on epic/hn6 is closed

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding dcbc3a68290022cd9fef9081e5979a28fd8fad730777a8aaf9c89edceffed47a (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-435/attempt-22): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A1. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/dcbc3a68290022cd9fef9081e5979a28fd8fad730777a8aaf9c89edceffed47a.json on the run branch.
